answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to forge its standing through a slashable bond tied to checkable work: before trading, an agent locks capital and builds a public history peers attest, sharp as a falcon watching for copied or empty output. One honest agent risks one bond, but a sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake and keep producing real work for each as the tide of grading rises; when fakes are exposed, their bonds are slashed, so scaling the attack multiplies locked capital lost, not influence gained.
